title: Final: performance
cards/0/task: Start with Substring and find a way with no allocations.
cards/1/task: The method takes the matrix by ref. Make it safe and copy-free.
cards/2/explain: A ref struct cannot be boxed: an object lives on the heap.
cards/3/q: You need to pass a buffer to an async method that writes to a stream. What do you pass?
cards/3/explain: A Span cannot be held across an await.
cards/4/q: What reduces pressure on the GC? Select all.
cards/4/explain: ToList creates a new list — that is extra garbage.
cards/5/pairs/1/1: A window for the heap and async
cards/6/q: Why can't a Span be a field of a class?
cards/6/options/0: It may point into the stack, and a class object outlives the method — the window would point at garbage
cards/6/explain: ref struct is how the compiler guarantees safety without run-time checks.
cards/7/q: in + a regular (non-readonly) struct with two method calls inside. How many defensive copies?
cards/7/options/0: Two — one before each method call
cards/7/explain: Each method call on an in parameter is made on a copy.
